result.summary: The page is generally well-formed; explicitly excluded edge-clipped carousel items and bottom viewport cutoff were not reported. One notable inconsistency remains: the Pizza category filter appears selected while the visible restaurant results are not pizza-specific.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' category chip is shown as selected (highlighted black), but the visible listings include poké, burgers, and ramen rather than pizza results, suggesting the active filter is not reflected in the content.
issues.suggestion: Ensure selecting a category chip actually filters all relevant sections, or visually clear/reset the selected chip when unfiltered recommendations are shown.
